intro: Old Murk-Eye is an infamous, battle-hardened murloc prowling the southern coastline of Westfall. Revered among his kind and feared by coastal sailors, he serves as a lethal menace to anyone wandering near the Westfall Lighthouse.

p: While murlocs are a common pest along the shores of Westfall, Old Murk-Eye stands apart from the lesser scavengers. Considerably tougher and far more aggressive than his kin, this grizzled beast prowls the surf surrounding the Westfall Lighthouse. His continued presence has caused enough grief to local mariners that the spectral Captain Grayson seeks his death, offering a bounty for the creature's pristine scales to break his grip on the shallows.
